fact: Tanzania's civil registration agency RITA is to be linked with the National Identification Authority NIDA, and a legal framework for this was announced in January as being prepared.

The government plans to integrate the functions of NIDA and RITA and is amending the Registration and Identification of Persons Act so the Jamii Namba is issued from birth and shown on birth certificates, per the Deputy Minister.
The NIDA Director General said NIDA plans to connect the national ID with services including the birth certificate, from four services now to nine.
NIDA director general James Kaji said birth certificates and some RITA functions are intended to move onto the national ID, so that many civil services sit with NIDA.
NIDA says the Jamii Number is issued once in a lifetime and deactivated at death, with a CRVS-ID data sharing API fully operational.
NIDA says the NIDA-RITA merger announced in 2023 is to be completed from 2026.
NIDA lists national ID and CRVS merging and children registration among its strategic priorities for 2026-2029, with the Jamii Number integrating birth registration.
